user.title: Connect Trello
user.description: Trello needs an API key from a Power-Up you own. Open the [Power-Up admin portal]({admin_url}), choose **New**, fill in the form (leave the Iframe connector URL blank), then open **API key** and generate one. Paste it below.

token.title: Authorise Home Assistant
token.description: [Click here to authorise]({auth_url}) Home Assistant to read and update your boards, then paste the token Trello shows you.

boards.title: Choose boards
boards.description: Each board becomes one to-do list in Home Assistant.

data.use_webhook: Instant updates via webhook (needs Nabu Casa or an external URL; otherwise polls every minute)

lists.title: Columns on {board}
lists.description: Ticking a task in Home Assistant moves its card to the Done column. New tasks are added to the second column you pick.

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: A card with a day label (Mon … Sun, Daily, Weekdays, Weekend) repeats. Its due date is the deadline; ticking it marks the due date complete, and after the rollover time it moves on to its next day.

data.rollover: Rollover time (the day boundary for ticks)
data.routine_default_time: Deadline for a routine card with no due date
data.carry_over: A missed routine stays overdue until ticked (off: it resets to its next day)

error.invalid_auth: Trello rejected the key or token.

abort.already_configured: This Trello account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Trello account.

autotick.title: Chores that tick themselves
autotick.description: Link a chore to the state that proves it done, such as Run the dishwasher to the dishwasher being running. When the entity goes into that state, the card is ticked, if it is due today or carried over. Unticking it by hand wins until the entity goes into the state again.

data.entity: Add: the entity that shows it was done
data.states: Add: the state that means done (comma between several)

error.incomplete_link: Pick the chore, the entity and the state.
error.unknown_card: That card is not on a board here.

abort.not_loaded: Trello To-do has to be running to choose a card. Try again once it has loaded.

move_card.name: Move card
move_card.description: Move a Trello card to another column.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The card's id (the to-do item uid).

list.name: Column
list.description: Column name or id, e.g. Doing.

set_members.name: Set assignees
set_members.description: Replace who a card is assigned to.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The card's id (the to-do item uid).

members.name: Members
members.description: Names, usernames or ids. Empty to unassign.

add_card.name: Add card
add_card.description: Add a card to a chosen column, optionally assigned and with a due date.

list.name: Column
list.description: Column name or id. Defaults to the new-tasks column.

members.name: Members
members.description: Names, usernames or ids to assign.

due.name: Due
due.description: Due date or date and time.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays the card repeats on: mon … sun, or daily, weekdays, weekend. Makes the card a routine.

time.name: Time
time.description: Deadline, HH:MM. With days: on each of those days. Alone: today, or tomorrow if it has gone.

start.name: Start
start.description: When it starts asking. HH:MM opens the window that day, before the deadline (the dishwasher from 20:00 for a 22:30 deadline). A full date and time sets it outright. Without it, from the start of its day.
